testListing.propertyProved: Every resolved package has a Go-discovered top-level test list; zero-test packages are explicit facts.
testListing.propertyNotProved: `go test -list` does not execute test bodies.

raceEvidence.propertyProved: The shared relationship package executes with race instrumentation; TestSharedServerRelationships exercises one root-built server, isolated explicit Factory Sessions, controlled mock-worker gates, public Work projections, and Factory Event ordering.

raceEvidence.diagnosticReference: Terminal JSON package event was pass; all 12 named TestSharedServerRelationships subtests were pass.

timingEvidence.sampleProcedure: For each package: run `go clean -testcache`, then direct `go test -json -short -p=1 -parallel=2 $package -count=1 -timeout=5m` three sequential times.
timingEvidence.failurePolicy: Failed, skipped, timed-out, or diagnostically incomplete samples remain recorded and are never replaced.
